declarations.description:
Inline message bar: an icon, text and an optional action or dismiss button (after
PostHog's `LemonBanner`).
declarations.name: HtBanner

slots.description: Action button at the end of the bar.
slots.name: action

members.name: tone
members.description: `info` is neutral. The others tint the bar. `danger` is announced assertively.

members.name: dismissible

events.description: The dismiss button was pressed. The banner hides itself unless this is cancelled.
events.name: ht-dismiss

declarations.description:
Surface for grouping related content. Optional header strip (with the halftone dot
screen) and footer.

declarations.description:
Keycap button, modelled on the buttons in Sentry's app (sentry.io/auth/login). The face
sits raised over a plate: it lifts 1px on hover and presses flush on click. Renders a
link when `href` is set.
declarations.name: HtButton

cssProperties.description: Border radius used when `flush` is set. `ht-dialog` sets this for its footer.
cssProperties.name: --ht-flush-radius

slots.name: suffix

members.description: `primary` accent keycap, `default` neutral keycap, `danger` red keycap, `quiet` flat with a hover tint.

members.name: size
members.description: Height: xs 24px, sm 28px, md 32px, lg 36px.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and form submission.

members.name: type
members.description: Native button behaviour inside a form. Ignored when `href` is set.

members.name: href
members.description: Renders an `<a>` and navigates instead of acting as a button.

declarations.description:
Single-line text field with label, helper and error text, styled like Sentry's app fields. Participates in forms,
constraint validation and form reset like a native input.

declarations.description:
Modal dialog on the native `<dialog>` element: focus trap, Escape to close and
top-layer stacking come from the browser.

Footer buttons flush to the bottom edge with mixed corner radii (Taskscape's signature).
Put the primary action first; `ht-button`s in the footer get `flush` set automatically.
declarations.name: HtDialog

members.name: open
members.description: Shows the dialog. Reflects: closing from inside updates it.

members.name: heading
members.description: Title text. Use the `title` slot for anything richer.

members.name: eyebrow
members.description: Small uppercase mono label above the title.

members.name: persistent
members.description: Blocks Escape and backdrop-click dismissal and hides the close button.

members.name: show
members.description: Opens the dialog.

members.name: close
members.description: Closes the dialog.

events.description: The dialog closed, by any route (Escape, backdrop, close button, `open = false`).
events.name: ht-close

declarations.description:
Keyboard shortcut hint. Each key gets its own small keycap (after PostHog's
